name: durable-derived-credentials-across-instance-recreate
description: Per-run credentials a retained sandbox carries in its env must be DERIVED from persisted server state (hex HMAC-SHA256 over an HKDF branch of SESSION_SECRET scoped to the run id), never per-spawn random: a container recreate replaces the server instance and per-spawn randomness silently orphans the sandbox's credential (work#1174: auto-resumed runs 403ed on every work-channel call). Implemented in fabro-server worker_token.rs run_channel_handshake_token + auth/keys.rs derive_run_channel_handshake_key; pinned by tests/it/api/run_channel.rs a_respawned_channel_accepts_the_sandboxes_original_token (fresh AppState, same secret, same socket path, original token passes).

The host-release recipe shipped with the production host's address, SSH port and root user as justfile PARAMETER DEFAULTS in the public fabro repo — internal deployment configuration in a public tree, exactly the class ADR-0041's fabro-tofu-stays-separate consequence exists to prevent. Caught by user review 2026-11-09, one leak site only (justfile line), fixed forward in the same window; pushed history retains it. Rule: recipes in public repos take host identity as REQUIRED caller-supplied parameters with no defaults; the identity home is fabro-tofu envs/ or gopass, never a repo file.
resolution: justfile host-release takes host/port as required params; comment names the rule and the incident.
